units.passage: Ensure AI use complies with copyright, intellectual property, and privacy laws.
units.why: 'Ensure AI use complies with copyright, intellectual property, and privacy laws' is a legal-compliance rule (P77).

units.passage: Ensure that AI systems comply with applicable laws and regulations governing the collection, storage, and use of student data, including the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and other relevant state and federal privacy laws.
units.why: AI systems must comply with laws on student data 'including the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)', legal compliance (P77).

units.passage: Applicable records must be retained and then destroyed in accordance with the Commonwealth’s Records Retention Schedules.
units.why: "Applicable records must be retained and then destroyed in accordance with the Commonwealth's Records Retention Schedules" ties records to existing law: P77.

units.passage: Ecampus will adhere to OSU’s Guidance for AI Use in Teaching and Learning
units.why: Ecampus 'will adhere to OSU's Guidance for AI Use in Teaching and Learning' alongside its own rules, which makes the university guidance binding on this work (P77).

units.passage: Use of AI should always be in alignment with Penn’s Principles of Responsible Conduct
units.why: "Use of AI should always be in alignment with Penn's Principles of Responsible Conduct" requires AI use to follow existing university policy (P77).

units.passage: All use of AI should be in line with Penn’s Code of Student Conduct and the Code of Academic Integrity
units.why: "All use of AI should be in line with Penn's Code of Student Conduct and the Code of Academic Integrity" ties AI use to existing conduct policy (P77).

units.passage: Under Penn’s Code of Academic Integrity , students may not use unauthorized assistance in their academic work.
units.why: Under the Code of Academic Integrity, "students may not use unauthorized assistance"; the text applies existing integrity policy to AI (P77).

units.passage: Be sure to follow applicable state and federal laws, including, but not limited to:
units.why: 'Be sure to follow applicable state and federal laws' (FERPA, HIPAA, GLBA follow in the list) is a duty to comply with existing law when using AI, which is P77 rather than P50, since it does not itself address protecting data in prompts.

units.passage: Any use of software to assist with grading must comply with Senate Policy 47-20 Basis for Grades
units.why: Requires AI-assisted grading to follow an existing Senate policy, a comply-with-existing-policy rule (P77).

units.passage: While PCC does not yet have any specific Artificial Intelligence policy, we do have board-approved policies in place that are applicable and can offer immediate interim guidance
units.why: "PCC does not yet have any specific Artificial Intelligence policy" with "board-approved policies in place that are applicable" for "interim guidance": existing policies (academic integrity, conduct, IT use, privacy, proprietary content, accessibility) govern AI. P77 (comply with existing policy) fits best; the word "interim" also signals provisional status.
units.fit_note: Also says the college has no specific AI policy yet and the guidance is interim (P54); the type captures only the reliance on existing policies. (Merged from both coders.)

units.passage: When using or procuring AI tools, please be sure to follow PSU’s guidelines and policies, see below for more information.
units.why: "When using or procuring AI tools, please be sure to follow PSU's guidelines and policies" ties tool use to existing university policy (P77).

units.passage: All work submitted in this course must be your own and completed per the University’s Administrative Guidelines on Academic Integrity.
units.policy: Work submitted in the course must be completed per the University's Administrative Guidelines on Academic Integrity.
units.why: 'All work submitted in this course must be your own and completed per the University's Administrative Guidelines on Academic Integrity' ties course work to existing university policy. P77 (comply with existing university policy) fits; P36 does not because no AI misuse is classified as misconduct and no process is named.

units.passage: We have developed this guidance in response to these questions, and also advise you to review the University’s
units.why: 'advise you to review the University's policies on AI' tells instructors to read the university policy before setting course rules. P77 is nearest because it ties course practice to existing university policy; the fit_note says it is advice to instructors.
units.fit_note: Advises instructors to read the university policy; does not state a compliance duty. / A recommendation to read the policy, not a compliance mandate.

units.passage: El uso individual de la IA en el ambiente laboral, académico o investigativo de la Universidad estará sujeto a las normas de conducta establecidas en la s políticas, reglamentos institucionales y las leyes aplicables.
units.policy: Individual use of AI in the University's work, academic or research environment is subject to the conduct norms established in institutional policies, regulations and applicable laws.
units.why: Individual AI use at work, academic or research settings "estará sujeto a las normas de conducta establecidas" in policies and laws, which makes existing rules apply (P77).

units.passage: El uso individual de la IA deberá cumplir con la normativa vigente de uso aceptable de la tecnología.
units.policy: Individual use of AI must comply with the current acceptable-use policy for technology, including AI services acquired by users as productivity tools or adopted by the University.
units.why: Individual use "deberá cumplir con la normativa vigente de uso aceptable de la tecnología", including public or private services; existing acceptable-use policy applies, P77.

units.policy: Institutional policies and regulations may be applied if AI is used improperly in the University's work, academic or research environment.
units.why: Institutional policies "podrán ser aplicados si se utiliza la IA de forma indebida" at work, academic or research settings, putting misuse under existing policies, P77.
